title: P300-M Balogo Port in Marinduque set to open in June 2027

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Residents of the Marinduque towns of Santa Cruz and Torrijos will enjoy shorter, cheaper trips when the P300-million Balogo Port opens in June 2027, providing an alternative docking facility to Balanacan Port in Mogpog. Marinduque lone district Rep. Reynaldo Salvacion said the new port would make sea travel more convenient by cutting the distance they would traverse to reach Balanacan Port, a key gateway connecting the island province to mainland Luzon, according to a report from the Philippine Information Agency in Marinduque.
